descripcion: Foto lifestyle a sangre, cálida y real, del producto en su contexto de uso (en manos de alguien o en un rincón de casa, baño, cocina u oficina). Encima, en la parte inferior, una tarjeta blanca de reseña con 5 estrellas, una cita corta entre comillas y una fila con avatar redondo, nombre y «compra verificada». Se siente como una reseña real de un cliente: genera confianza sin parecer anuncio.
reference_style: Authentic lifestyle photo with a clean review card overlay (stars, quote, avatar and name), styled like a native customer review

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The lifestyle photo with the product in real use. 2) The five stars. 3) The quote. 4) The avatar, name and verified label that make it credible.
art_direction.composition_style: Full-bleed photo with a single floating card. The product and the action live in the upper 52-56% of the canvas; the review card floats over the lower part, centered horizontally, overlapping only background areas of the photo and never the product.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Card: about 84% of the canvas width (8% to 92%) and 36-40% of its height (top edge at about 54-58%, bottom edge at about 94%), corner radius about 3% of the canvas, inner padding about 4%. Inside the card, top to bottom: stars row (about 3% tall), a gap of about 2%, the quote (max 3 lines), a gap of about 2.5%, then the customer row (about 6.5% tall). Product in the photo: about 35-42% of the canvas height, between about 8% and 52% of the height, centered or slightly off-center.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Photo: warm natural window light, soft shadows, a realistic lived-in setting, shallow depth of field with the product sharp and the background softly blurred; candid smartphone-photo authenticity with good composition. Card: flat white with a soft, diffuse drop shadow (about 10-15% opacity) so it floats above the photo.

layout_summary: Square canvas filled edge to edge with a warm, authentic lifestyle photo showing the user's product in its moment of use, placed in the upper part of the frame. Over the lower part, a white rounded review card centered horizontally: a row of five filled stars at its top-left, a short quote in 2-3 lines below, and at the bottom a customer row with a small round avatar photo, the customer's name and a small verified label with a check icon. No other elements.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the product living in a real customer's life, which makes the review believable
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Show the user's product in its natural moment of use for the target audience: hands applying, holding or using it, or the product placed in the real room where it is used. If a person appears, show them naturally (hands, partial body or a relaxed face) matching the target audience. It must feel like a customer's own photo, not a studio set. Keep the lower 45% of the frame calm (table, wall, soft blurred background) because the card sits there.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Upper-middle area of the photo, between about 8% and 52% of the canvas height, about 35-42% of the canvas height, never covered by the card
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows exactly what the review is about
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), naturally integrated in the scene, sharply in focus, label facing the camera.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Lower part of the canvas, centered horizontally, about 84% of the width and 36-40% of the height, bottom edge at about 94% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Frames the customer's words as a genuine review
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Clean white or off-white rounded rectangle in a generic, native review style (no platform interface, no platform logos), with a soft diffuse drop shadow.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top-left inside the card, aligned with the inner padding
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Signals satisfaction before the quote is read
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Five filled stars, each about 3% of the canvas height, in gold or the brand accent, evenly spaced.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom-left inside the card, in the customer row
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Puts a real face behind the words
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small circular photo about 6.5% of the canvas in diameter: a realistic headshot of a person matching the target audience. If a person appears in the main photo, the avatar shows the same person.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Customer row, to the right of the avatar, at the start of the verified label line
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small solid check-in-circle icon in green or the brand accent, about 2.4% of the canvas height.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the card, below the stars, left-aligned
text_layers.text_style: Medium or semi-bold sans-serif, about 3.4-3.8% of the canvas height, max 3 lines, left-aligned, near-black on the white card, wrapped in opening and closing quotation marks; the key phrase may be set in bold
text_layers.guia_texto: La reseña en primera persona, de 8 a 16 palabras, natural y específica: un resultado concreto, el momento en que lo notó o la duda que superó. Debe sonar a cliente real, no a marketing.

text_layers.reference_position: Customer row, right of the avatar, top line
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, about 2.8-3.2% of the canvas height, 1 line, left-aligned, near-black
text_layers.guia_texto: Nombre + inicial del apellido (por ejemplo «Laura M.»), acorde al país y al público objetivo.

text_layers.reference_position: Customer row, under the name, right after the check icon
text_layers.text_style: Regular sans-serif, about 2.3-2.6% of the canvas height, 1 line, left-aligned, mid-grey
text_layers.guia_texto: Etiqueta de verificación en 2 o 3 palabras («Compra verificada» o «Cliente verificado»).

mandatory_visual_elements: Full-bleed, warm, authentic lifestyle photo with the user's product in use
White rounded review card floating over the lower part of the photo
Row of five filled stars at the top of the card
Small round avatar with the customer's name and a verified check icon
forbidden_additions: Headline or any text outside the card
Price, discount, offer or urgency badge
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
Aggregate rating summary (average score or number of reviews)
Real platform logos or interface elements of review sites or social networks
notas_paleta: Colores nativos de la escena para la foto (cálidos y naturales), con la paleta de marca presente en detalles del set (textiles, fondo u objetos). La tarjeta es blanca y neutra como una reseña real; el color de marca solo aparece en las estrellas (o en dorado) y en el ícono de verificación.
